# runr_cost_limit (Data Source)

A project's monthly cost limit and this month so far: the figures the project's Billing tab shows (`runr_cost_limit` the resource sets the limit). Null figures for a project the limit does not apply to (`available = false`: a fixed-price project or a free region). Needs the project's owner, `projects.billing` on the project or `billing.view`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "runr_cost_limit" "api" {
  project_id = runr_project.api.id
}

output "api_month_so_far" {
  value = "${data.runr_cost_limit.api.month_to_date} of ${data.runr_cost_limit.api.amount} ${data.runr_cost_limit.api.currency} (${data.runr_cost_limit.api.state})"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) Project id.

### Read-Only

- `action` (String) `notify` or `stop`; null without a limit.
- `amount` (Number) The limit; null without one.
- `available` (Boolean) A limit applies to the project (a pay-as-you-go project).
- `can_resume` (Boolean) The project can be resumed: the limit stopped it and no longer stops it.
- `checked_at` (String) When the limit was last checked.
- `currency` (String) The billing currency.
- `forecast` (Number) This month so far ÷ elapsed days × days in the month.
- `month_to_date` (Number) What the project's bills of this month come to so far.
- `percent` (Number) This month so far in percent of the limit.
- `period` (String) This month (`2026-10`).
- `reached_at` (String) When this month reached the limit.
- `state` (String) `none` (no limit), `ok`, `warning` or `reached`.
- `stopped` (Boolean) The limit keeps the project stopped.
- `warned_at` (String) When this month's warning went out.
- `warning_percent` (Number) Percent of the limit at which the owner is warned (80).
